<plan>
drive car1 myagang-shelter uttargaya-school
load car1 child 2
drive car1 uttargaya-school nilkantha-market
drive car1 nilkantha-market syaphru-temple
load car1 elderly 2
drive car1 syaphru-temple nilkantha-market
drive car1 nilkantha-market uttargaya-school
drive car1 uttargaya-school myagang-shelter
unload car1 child 2
unload car1 elderly 2
defer syaphru-temple adult 1
</plan>
COST: 154

This plan rescues the two pupils and the two pensioners, and defers the farmer. The car's round trip takes 134 minutes (28 + 8 + 31 out, and 31 + 8 + 28 back). The bridge is out, so the route runs through Uttargaya school, and the pupils ride along on the way out. Carrying all five people would need a second run costing another 134 minutes, which is more than the 20-minute penalty for deferring the adult.

The plan assumes roads can be driven in both directions. The field report doesn't say otherwise.
